Job Overview: We are looking for a senior Brand Marketing Associate Manager to join our Marketing team in Italy. This is a newly created role, with full ownership of how the InPost brand is built, perceived and experienced in the Italian market. The ideal candidate can build a brand personality that genuinely resonates with the Italian audience, drawing on the Group's global brand platform but giving it its own voice and creative territory locally. The role reports to the Head of Marketing and is the senior point of reference for brand strategy, content and reputation in Italy, acting as the guardian of the brand in the Italian market. Responsibilities and Duties: • Define the brand strategy for Italy, including positioning, creative territory and growth priorities, based on brand health data and business objectives. • Build and own a brand personality for Italy, translating the Group's global brand platform into a tone, character and creative identity that genuinely works for the local audience. • Initiate and lead brand building projects, such as campaigns, creative territories, distinctive brand assets and high profile partnerships, to grow the brand's relevance and recognition in the market. • Set and own brand health goals for Italy, such as awareness, consideration and brand equity, using brand tracking data as the basis for strategic decisions. • Define the strategy and the content editorial plan across channels, including website, social and product communication, as part of the broader brand strategy, ensuring brand identity consistency across all channels and materials • Oversee the brand's online reputation and social media presence, keeping it consistent with brand voice and business priorities. • Select and brief creative, content and communication agencies, evaluating their work on the basis of brand impact. • Act as the Italian market's voice within the Group's international brand community, building on the Group's brand identity, tone of voice and naming frameworks as the foundation for everything developed locally. • Build strategic alignment across the wider Marketing organisation, partnering with peer teams in other markets and with Legal, Product/Commercial, Tech, PR and Customer Experience, so the brand speaks with one voice everywhere it shows up. • Manage and develop a team, defining priorities and planning. Key Skills: • 10+ years of experience in senior Brand Strategy, Brand Management or Brand Marketing roles, with real ownership of building, repositioning or transforming a brand. • Proven experience in social media management, with up-to-date knowledge of platform trends and best practices. • Experience developing brand platforms, creative territories or brand personas with a demonstrable business impact, ideally in multi market, retail, e-commerce or logistics environments. • Ability to translate brand health data and business vision into strategic decisions, with full decision making autonomy and accountability for results. • Seniority and executive presence to operate as a peer with senior, international stakeholders. • Proven experience managing and developing people, managing brand budgets, and selecting and directing creative and communication agencies. • Fluent in Italian and English, written and spoken. testo_completo: Milan, Italy Hybrid About us Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of. What you'll be doing As our Country Manager - Merchant, you’ll play a key role in driving sales and profitable growth across Satispay’s core merchant business. You will hold the strategic and operational responsibility, including the P&L (profit and loss), for our core merchant ecosystem, the most iconic and foundational business we have. Your mission is to maximize sales, find new ways to monetize, lead our commercial teams, and be the strongest advocate for merchants’ needs and market trends. This is a permanent role based in Milan, with a flexible hybrid working policy. This is an opportunity to lead within a high-growth, constantly evolving environment – a challenge perfectly suited for an executive ready to navigate and shape change at scale and contribute to something bigger. Here's what your day-to-day will look like: Own the Merchant P&L and strategy - Define, drive, and execute the commercial strategy for the Merchant business, delivering sustainable revenue growth and profitability. Lead and scale the sales teams - Directly manage and mentor the sales organization. Sharpen commercial processes, targets, and performance to maximize market penetration. Be the voice of the merchant - Dig into merchants’ needs, pain points, and industry trends, and turn them into clear, actionable feedback for our product and growth strategies. Spot monetization opportunities - Keep analyzing the merchant landscape to identify, test, and launch new feature-driven or service-driven ways to monetize. Thrive in a matrix structure - Work closely with cross-functional teams, such as Product and Growth, among others, to align the product roadmap with merchant expectations and make execution seamless. You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership. Who we're looking for This role needs a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors. You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results, and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment. Business acumen and P&L ownership - 5-8+ years in senior leadership roles (General Manager, Head of Business or VP of Sales) with full accountability for a business line’s P&L, ideally scaling merchant-facing or business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) business lines. Sales leadership - Proven experience directly managing, structuring, and motivating high-performing sales teams, preferably in Fintech, Payments, Retail Tech, or Marketplace, backed by a strong commercial drive. Experience and expertise in acquiring, payment acceptance, and point-of-sale (POS) solutions is a plus. Monetization and growth mindset - A sharp eye for untapped revenue streams, upselling opportunities, and strategic partnerships within a merchant ecosystem. Matrix organization expertise - Strong ability to navigate and influence in a matrix environment, bridging the gap between field sales and central product and growth teams. Customer-centric, trend-driven approach - Genuine passion for understanding merchant dynamics, physical and digital retail trends, and shifting consumer behaviors. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops. 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries. ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply. 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours. 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness. *We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Initial salary: Starting from €120,000.00 gross per annum This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.
